queries.query: What principles govern the processing of personal data?
queries.ground_truth: Personal data shall be processed lawfully, fairly and in a transparent manner.

queries.query: What is the right to erasure of personal data?
queries.ground_truth: The data subject shall have the right to obtain the erasure of personal data concerning him or her without undue delay.

queries.query: When must a personal data breach be notified to the supervisory authority?
queries.ground_truth: The controller shall notify the personal data breach to the supervisory authority not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it.
